description: Header file defining the Queue class used in QUIC simulator for packet queuing with aggregation features.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: A finitely sized packet queue with aggregation capabilities, used in QUIC simulation.

classes.name: Queue::ListenerInterface
classes.description: Interface for listening to queue events such as packet dequeuing.

classes.name: Queue::EnqueuedPacket
classes.description: Structure representing a packet enqueued in the Queue with an associated bundle number.

classes.name: Queue::AggregationAlarmDelegate
classes.description: Alarm delegate for handling aggregation timeout events.

methods.name: set_tx_port
methods.description: Sets the transmission port for the queue.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet into the queue.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Performs queue actions, such as dequeuing packets.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the queue in bytes.

methods.name: bytes_queued
methods.description: Returns the current number of bytes queued.

methods.name: packets_queued
methods.description: Returns the number of packets currently queued.

methods.name: set_listener_interface
methods.description: Sets the listener interface for queue events.

methods.name: EnableAggregation
methods.description: Enables packet aggregation with specified threshold and timeout.

methods.name: NextBundle
methods.description: Advances to the next aggregation bundle, flushing current packets.

methods.name: ScheduleNextPacketDequeue
methods.description: Schedules the next packet dequeue operation.
